name: VegetationManagementPlanner
tagline: From encroachment finding to audited clearance – every span, every crew, every cycle.
description: Vegetation management app for electric utilities: clearance-driven P1 / P2 / P3 priorities with wildfire-zone standards, landowner permission, trim cycles per circuit, work packages issued to contractor crews, start / complete with post-work clearance, audits and rework – in canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Measured vs required clearance per voltage class with wildfire-zone extra
Suggested P1 / P2 / P3 priority and automatic due dates
Landowner permission rules (pending blocks, refused escalates)
Trim cycle per circuit with span strip
Work packages issued to contractor crews with PackageJson
Crew start / complete with hours and post-work clearance
Audit pass / fail → rework, on-time completion and audit pass rate
Supervisor-only deferral of P1 and wildfire P2 work
Bulk plan / priority / defer / issue, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events, demo mode, phone layout, Power Pages contractor portal
